text:
anya: quick copy review for the rollout confirmation modal (model route changes). current wording feels vague: modal title is `Confirm rollout` and body says `Are you sure you want to proceed?` we should clarify impact and timing.

sam: totally. users need to know what will change and whether traffic shifts immediately. propose:
- title: `Confirm rollout`
- body: `This will route live traffic from the current model variant to the selected variant. Traffic will shift immediately and cannot be undone. Do you want to continue?`

marta: wording nit: `cannot be undone` is a bit alarmist and might be untrue if we support rollbacks. maybe `This change can be rolled back, but users may see brief errors during the switch.` Hm. Also prefer shorter sentences for screen readers.

des: design pattern note: include a small callout with estimated time and impact, e.g. `Expected disruption: ~10s of increased latency` so users have a sense. Also place the destructive action (Confirm rollout) as primary? that sounds odd. We usually have `Confirm` as primary but maybe call it `Start rollout` as primary and `Cancel` as secondary.

liam: a11y stuff: modal should be explicit about what will happen. Try: `This will start routing 100% of production traffic to Variant B immediately. Some in-flight requests may error; retry logic will be attempted.` Also ensure `role=dialog` and aria-describedby link to the explanation.

anya: okay, let's converge on precise microcopy to sync Figma. Draft: 
- title: `Confirm rollout`
- body: `You're about to route production traffic from Variant A to Variant B. Traffic will shift immediately; some in-flight requests may fail. This change can be rolled back.`
- tertiary note (small text): `Estimated impact: brief increase in latency for up to 30s. Retry logic will be applied.`
- buttons: `Start rollout` (primary), `Cancel` (secondary).

marta: tiny nit: `some in-flight requests may fail` -> maybe friendlier: `some in-flight requests may be interrupted` also mention observability: `Monitor the rollout in the Console`?

sam: add link to route dashboard in the body: `Monitor the rollout in the Console -> Routes` (link). Also, I think we should avoid the word `production` for customers with staging. Maybe `live traffic` is clearer.

anya: updated draft with those nits: 
- body: `You're about to route live traffic from Variant A to Variant B. Traffic will shift immediately; some in-flight requests may be interrupted. This change can be rolled back.`
- small note: `Estimated impact: brief increase in latency for up to 30s. Retry logic will be applied. Monitor the rollout in the Console -> Routes.`

des: button labels: `Start rollout` + `Cancel` fine. Also include a checkbox `I understand the risks` for extra safety on high-impact rollouts? If we add it, copy: `I understand that this will affect live traffic.` But that is a product decision — flagging for PM.

liam: if we include the checkbox, ensure it's keyboard reachable and labels are associated correctly. aria-describedby for the checkbox to explain what `risks` means.

anya: let's ship without the checkbox for the v1 copy, but I'll prototype the checkbox as an optional control in Figma. Final agreed strings for v1: 
- title: `Confirm rollout`
- body: `You're about to route live traffic from Variant A to Variant B. Traffic will shift immediately; some in-flight requests may be interrupted. This change can be rolled back.`
- note: `Estimated impact: brief increase in latency for up to 30s. Retry logic will be applied. Monitor the rollout in the Console -> Routes.`
- buttons: `Start rollout` (primary), `Cancel` (secondary)

design-bot: Button patterns -> https://docs.redwood.design/button-patterns (primary right). Also recommended microcopy doc: https://docs.redwood.design/microcopy-guidelines.

marta: i'll run a quick screen-reader pass once this lands.
des: i'll update the Figma modal and adjust the visual callout for impact.

anya: thanks all  i'll push copy to the repo and attach the Figma link in #design-copy when ready. :rocket:
